title: Stakeholder observation
description: One evaluative dimension of one stakeholder group, mined from one source document with verbatim evidence.

stakeholder_name.title: Stakeholder
stakeholder_name.description: The stakeholder group as the document itself names it, in at most 60 characters, for example "commuter students".

description.title: Observation
description.description: What this group is, as the document presents it.

dimension.title: Aspect
dimension.description: Short label of what this group evaluates: a need, value, objection or expectation.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: The exact sentence from the document that proves the dimension.

source.title: Document
source.description: Key of the source document, such as SRC-002.
